verdict.rationale: Rollbar documents an official MCP server and a REST API that can list error and critical items in the production environment. Stack traces carry file, line and method data, and statuses and owners support triage. A Rollbar staff comment confirms a JIRA integration exists, which an agent could use to file bugs. missing for 10: documentation of which MCP tools are exposed (e.g., fetching occurrence stack traces), explicit API docs for retrieving full stack traces, first-party docs for tracker issue creation via API/MCP, and independent hands-on corroboration of the agent workflow.
